supplements.title: Curative effect of acupuncture combined with Chinese medicine on cancer pain: Systematic review and meta-analysis.
supplements.summary: Acupuncture combined with Chinese medicine may help reduce cancer pain, according to a review of multiple studies.

supplements.title: Phytocannabinoids as epigenetic regulators: bridging DNA methylation and redox homeostasis in glioblastoma.
supplements.summary: Cannabinoids inhibit glioblastoma progression alone or combined with chemotherapy by reducing oxidative DNA damage.

supplements.title: Effect of tobacco avoidance on the incidence of non-hereditary renal cell carcinoma in patients over 18 years of age: systematic review and meta-analysis.
supplements.summary: Avoiding tobacco significantly reduces the risk of kidney cancer in adults without a family history of the disease.

supplements.title: Corydaline overcomes doxorubicin resistance in oral cancer by activating the p53-Bax-caspase axis and inhibiting MMP-driven invasion: an in vitro, in vivo, and in silico study.
supplements.summary: Corydaline, a natural compound, overcomes doxorubicin resistance in oral cancer by triggering cell death and blocking tumor spread.

supplements.title: JAK/STAT3 axis in breast cancer: opportunities for intervention with natural phytochemical-based nanotherapeutics.
supplements.summary: Nanoparticle delivery of natural plant compounds like resveratrol could improve breast cancer treatment by better targeting cancer-driving STAT3 proteins.

supplements.title: Biophysical and biological evaluation of free and liposomal doxorubicin and β-carotene reveals enhanced therapeutic selectivity in MCF-7 breast cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Liposomal delivery of doxorubicin with β-carotene reduces breast cancer cell toxicity while minimizing damage to healthy cells.

supplements.title: Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron Improves Colorectal Cancer Prognosis by Remodeling the Immune Microenvironment.
supplements.summary: A specific gut bacterium called Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron improves colorectal cancer outcomes by changing the immune environment.

supplements.title: Cardioprotective effects of platycodon grandiflorum granules in HER2-positive early breast cancer patients receiving trastuzumab plus pertuzumab: study protocol for a double blind randomized controlled trial.
supplements.summary: Study tests whether platycodon grandiflorum granules can protect the heart from damage in HER2-positive breast cancer patients receiving trastuzumab plus pertuzumab treatment.

supplements.title: Nicotinamide attenuates the virulence of colorectal cancer-associated Fusobacterium nucleatum.
supplements.summary: Nicotinamide, a form of vitamin B3, reduces the virulence of bacteria that promote colorectal cancer growth.

supplements.title: Effects and potential mechanisms of luteolin on cisplatin mediated inhibition of cervical adenocarcinoma.
supplements.summary: Luteolin enhances cisplatin's cancer-fighting effects against cervical cancer while reducing drug dosage and toxicity through cell cycle arrest and apoptosis.

supplements.title: Proteolysis-Assisted Cyclization Facilitates Site-Centric Target Deconvolution of Isothiocyanates.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed a new method to identify exactly where isothiocyanate molecules bind to proteins, revealing potential cancer prevention and treatment targets.

supplements.title: High-fat diet reshapes microbial interactions to promote breast cancer stemness via Streptococcus mutans-induced leucine accumulation.
supplements.summary: High-fat diets alter gut bacteria in ways that promote breast cancer growth through increased leucine production.

supplements.title: Effects of coenzyme Q10 on retinal inflammation in streptozotocin-induced diabetic rats.
supplements.summary: Coenzyme Q10 reduced inflammation and oxidative stress in the eyes of diabetic rats, potentially protecting against diabetes-related vision damage.

supplements.title: Synthesis and biological study of thiopheneyl/piperazinl-α-aminophosphonate-chitosan conjugates as biologically active carriers for controlled delivery of curcumin.
supplements.summary: Novel chitosan carriers loaded with curcumin show selective toxicity against multiple cancer cell types while sparing normal cells.

supplements.title: Antioxidant, pro-oxidant, cytotoxic and antimicrobial properties of selected plant phenolic compounds and resulting structure-activity relationships.
supplements.summary: Plant phenolic compounds, particularly gallic and tannic acids, show promise against melanoma cells by increasing oxidative stress while sparing normal cells.

off_label.title: Soluble Uric Acid Drives CD8⁺ T-cell Exhaustion by Inducing KSR1-Mediated MAPK Hyperactivation.
off_label.summary: High uric acid exhausts immune cells in colorectal cancer; lowering it restores anti-tumor immunity and enhances immunotherapy effectiveness.

off_label.title: Targeting the GSK-3β/mTOR axis to overcome chemoresistance in gestational choriocarcinoma: molecular mechanisms and therapeutic opportunities.
off_label.summary: Blocking GSK-3β and mTOR proteins may overcome chemotherapy resistance in gestational choriocarcinoma by restoring cancer cell death.

off_label.title: Rituximab Beyond Oncology: Targeting B-Cell-Mediated Immunomodulatory Therapy in Neurodegenerative and Neuropsychiatric Disorders.
off_label.summary: Rituximab, a B-cell-targeting drug, shows promise treating multiple neurological disorders by reducing brain inflammation and protecting neurons.

off_label.title: The telomerase/shelterin system is impaired in acromegaly and Cushing´s disease: Potential pathophysiological relevance.
off_label.summary: Pituitary tumor cells show abnormal telomerase activity that can be blocked with a drug to reduce growth, potentially offering a new treatment approach.

off_label.title: mTOR inhibition promotes ATRA-induced cancer cell differentiation by overcoming a metabolic hyperactive state.
off_label.summary: Combining mTOR inhibitors with vitamin A derivative ATRA improves cancer cell maturation in treatment-resistant acute myeloid leukemia and solid tumors.

off_label.title: Decreased PP2A expression and activity represent a therapeutic target for plexiform neurofibroma.
off_label.summary: Restoring PP2A phosphatase activity with FTY720 suppresses neurofibroma growth in NF1, alone and combined with MEK inhibitors.

off_label.title: Integrated clinical and computational data-based repurposing of econazole as a novel autophagic activator in ULK1-related Parkinson disease.
off_label.summary: Econazole, an existing antifungal drug, activates autophagy and shows promise for treating Parkinson disease by clearing toxic protein aggregates.

off_label.title: The role of STAT3 in regulating ferroptosis in cancer: molecular mechanisms and targeted therapeutic perspectives.
off_label.summary: STAT3 protein blocks ferroptosis in colorectal cancer cells; blocking STAT3 with drugs may trigger this alternative cell death pathway.

off_label.title: Ascites protects against ferroptosis and enables the peritoneal growth of ovarian cancer.
off_label.summary: Ascites fluid protects ovarian cancer cells from ferroptosis, enabling peritoneal metastasis; fibrates may reverse this protection.

off_label.title: Diving into AA9-mediated transglutaminase 2 inhibition reveals ferroptosis as driver of anticancer effects.
off_label.summary: AA9 inhibitor triggers ferroptosis in triple-negative breast cancer by blocking transglutaminase 2, offering a new treatment approach.

off_label.title: Current applications and development of dual-target inhibitors of Ido1/TDO: From tumor immunology to neuropsychiatric disorders.
off_label.summary: Dual-targeting IDO1 and TDO enzymes shows promise for cancer immunotherapy by overcoming single-drug resistance and tumor immune evasion.

off_label.title: Identification of PRRG1 as a possible molecular target of pancreatic cancer.
off_label.summary: PRRG1 protein drives pancreatic cancer growth through a key signaling pathway, and low-dose warfarin effectively blocks this effect.

off_label.title: Targeting UXS1-Dependent Glucuronate Detoxification Potentiates Metformin's Anti-Tumor Efficacy in Lung Adenocarcinoma.
off_label.summary: Blocking UXS1 enzyme combined with metformin kills lung adenocarcinoma cells and boosts immune responses in preclinical studies.

off_label.title: Tofacitinib as a Successful Treatment for Hyper-IgE Syndrome and Autoimmunity Associated with Constitutive Activation of JAK3.
off_label.summary: Tofacitinib successfully treated a patient with rare JAK3 mutations causing high-IgE syndrome and autoimmune disease.

off_label.title: Tamoxifen attenuates postsurgical hindlimb swelling and soft-tissue fibrosis in a rat model of secondary lymphatic injury.
off_label.summary: Tamoxifen reduces post-surgical limb swelling and tissue scarring in rats by lowering oxidative stress after lymph node removal.

biomarkers.title: Thiamine deficiency in outpatients at a regional cancer centre in Japan: cross-sectional observational study.
biomarkers.summary: Cancer outpatients at a Japanese center showed significant thiamine deficiency, suggesting routine vitamin screening may benefit this population.

biomarkers.title: Psychological stress and immune dysregulation: insights from neuroimmunology and the gut-brain-immune axis.
biomarkers.summary: Psychological stress impairs immune function through the gut-brain connection, potentially increasing cancer and disease risk.

biomarkers.title: A relative methylation ordering biomarker of lactylation-related genes predicts prognosis and therapeutic response in cutaneous melanoma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a methylation-based biomarker for melanoma that predicts patient survival and response to chemotherapy, immunotherapy, and targeted drugs.

biomarkers.title: Absence of autoantibodies linked to cancer and autoimmune disorders 26 weeks after BNT162b2 boosting in CoronaVac- primed individuals.
biomarkers.summary: Mixed COVID-19 vaccination (CoronaVac then BNT162b2 booster) showed no increase in cancer or autoimmune-related autoantibodies after 26 weeks.

biomarkers.title: Comprehensive analysis suggests CRIF1 is a potential target in breast cancer associated with prognosis and immune infiltration.
biomarkers.summary: CRIF1 protein levels in breast cancer cells may predict patient outcomes and affect immune cell presence in tumors.

biomarkers.title: Choroid plexus cyst burden is associated with glymphatic dysfunction and cognitive impairment in hepatic encephalopathy.
biomarkers.summary: Choroid plexus cysts in hepatic encephalopathy patients are linked to impaired brain fluid clearance and cognitive decline.

biomarkers.title: PRECISE-seq reveals disease-relevant TCR repertoires with phenotypic plasticity.
biomarkers.summary: PRECISE-seq reveals that tumor T cells adopt a regulatory state blocked by PD-1 inhibition, improving immunotherapy response prediction.

biomarkers.title: Epithelial chemokine CCL25 integrates T cell development and intestinal homeostasis.
biomarkers.summary: Epithelial cells use CCL25 protein to guide T cell development in the thymus and maintain intestinal health through tissue-specific signaling.

biomarkers.title: Integrative genomic and functional characterization of FAM3 family genes reveals their diagnostic and prognostic roles in kidney renal clear cell carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: FAM3 family genes show diagnostic and prognostic potential in kidney cancer, with epigenetic changes driving their dysregulation and affecting treatment response.

biomarkers.title: Identification of immunostimulatory antigens in Group A Streptococcus-derived vesicles.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified seven bacterial proteins in Group A Streptococcus vesicles that trigger immune responses and could form a broadly protective vaccine.

biomarkers.title: Glutaredoxin-1 attenuates transactive response DNA-binding protein 43-induced neurotoxicity by suppressing oxidative stress and transactive response DNA-binding protein 43 aggregation.
biomarkers.summary: Glutaredoxin-1 enzyme reduces nerve cell damage from toxic TDP-43 protein buildup by lowering oxidative stress and preventing protein clumping.

biomarkers.title: Inhibition of CCL4 prevents renal inflammation and fibrosis in acute kidney injury.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking CCL4 protein reduces kidney inflammation and damage in acute kidney injury by suppressing harmful immune responses.

biomarkers.title: Comparison of preoperative breast cancer disease extent on contrast-enhanced mammography (CEM) versus magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).
biomarkers.summary: Contrast-enhanced mammography and MRI perform similarly in detecting breast cancer size and additional tumors before surgery.

biomarkers.title: CBL proto-oncogene C-mediated synaptophysin 1 regulates prostate cancer progression in the TGF-beta signalling pathway.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified synaptophysin 1 as a key regulator of prostate cancer progression through the TGF-beta signaling pathway.

biomarkers.title: Tumor cell-derived exosomal E2F7 promotes colorectal cancer progression by interacting with SMC4 and induced macrophage M2 polarization.
biomarkers.summary: Colorectal cancer cells release E2F7 molecules that reprogram immune cells to support tumor growth and progression.

trials.title: Thiamine deficiency in outpatients at a regional cancer centre in Japan: cross-sectional observational study.
trials.summary: Cancer outpatients at a Japanese center showed significant thiamine deficiency, suggesting routine vitamin screening may benefit this population.

trials.title: Curative effect of acupuncture combined with Chinese medicine on cancer pain: Systematic review and meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Acupuncture combined with Chinese medicine may help reduce cancer pain, according to a review of multiple studies.

trials.title: A hierarchical self-adjuvanted nanoCRISPR-based vaccine restores endogenous immune recognition and surveillance to amplify adaptive immune responses.
trials.summary: A new CRISPR vaccine restores cancer immune recognition by editing two genes, increasing tumor visibility and reactivating immune cells to prevent metastasis.

trials.title: Field performance and acceptability of the hepatitis B core-related antigen rapid diagnostic test (HBcrAg-RDT) for detecting high viral load among pregnant women in The Gambia (PROTECT-B).
trials.summary: A rapid hepatitis B test accurately identifies pregnant women needing treatment to prevent infant infection in resource-limited settings.

trials.title: Clinical implications of RAS mutations in AML: Prognostic significance is based upon involved gene and mutation complexity.
trials.summary: KRAS mutations, especially complex ones, predict worse outcomes in AML, particularly in KMT2A-rearranged leukemia, while NRAS mutations show no prognostic impact.

trials.title: Collection of autologous CD34+ hematopoietic progenitor cells (HPC) in multiple myeloma: CD34 + cell collection yield in relation to molecular subtype, karyotype, and FISH results.
trials.summary: Researchers found that multiple myeloma's molecular subtypes and genetic features affect how many stem cells can be collected for transplant treatment.

trials.title: Sleeve Resection of the Right Upper Lobe for Tracheobronchial Metastasis of Hepatocellular Carcinoma With Superior Vena Cava Involvement: A Case Report and Literature Review.
trials.summary: Surgeons successfully treated rare lung metastasis from liver cancer using sleeve resection, preserving lung function while achieving complete tumor removal.

trials.title: Daratumumab-Bortezomib-Cyclophosphamide-Dexamethasone in Newly Diagnosed Amyloidosis: ANDROMEDA Final Survival Analysis.
trials.summary: Adding daratumumab to standard chemotherapy significantly improves survival and organ recovery in newly diagnosed light-chain amyloidosis patients.

trials.title: How we prevent infections in adults receiving bispecific antibody therapies for advanced B-cell malignancies.
trials.summary: Researchers propose infection prevention strategies for B-cell cancer patients receiving bispecific antibody therapies, which frequently cause dangerous immune suppression.

trials.title: Targeting PRMT9 Overcomes Venetoclax Resistance in AML by Modulating Splicing and Inhibiting Translation.
trials.summary: Blocking PRMT9 restores venetoclax effectiveness in drug-resistant acute myeloid leukemia by reducing drug efflux and survival proteins.

trials.title: CD4+ T-cells sensitize quasi-mesenchymal breast tumors lacking CD73 to anti-CTLA4 immune checkpoint blockade therapy.
trials.summary: Blocking CD73 in breast tumors restores CD4+ T-cell function, making immunotherapy effective against previously resistant cancers.

trials.title: Development and validation of subtype and risk models for kinase-related genes as novel prognostic features in breast cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers identified breast cancer subtypes and created a prognostic model using kinase genes to better predict patient outcomes.

trials.title: Loss of Kmt2c/d promotes gastric cancer and confers vulnerability to mTORC1 and PD1 inhibition.
trials.summary: Loss of KMT2C/D genes drives gastric cancer and makes tumors sensitive to mTORC1 and PD1 inhibitor combination therapy.

trials.title: Association between risk-reducing salpingooophorectomy and bone health in women with hereditary breast and ovarian cancer syndrome.
trials.summary: Removing ovaries to prevent cancer in high-risk women may weaken bones and increase fracture risk.

trials.title: Morphological and molecular characterization of epithelial ovarian cancer: SEOM-SEAP consensus guidelines for biomarker integration in clinical practice.
trials.summary: New guidelines recommend testing ovarian cancer tumors for specific genetic mutations and markers to personalize treatment and improve patient outcomes.
